headline: Approved a land deal with WinnDevelopment for Parcels 11 and 12, transferred $358,559 in opioid funds, and denied a motion on land-use lawsuits.
summary: The Council approved several grants and agreements, including a $118,915 Green Communities grant, a $117k jail/arrest diversion grant, a license agreement with Fork Included, LLC, and a land disposition agreement with WinnDevelopment for Parcels 11 and 12. It denied a motion asking the City Manager to study legal action against city land use boards, and transferred $358,559 in opioid settlement funds and $251,268.75 for an HHS lease. Several council requests were referred to the City Manager, two subcommittee reports were continued to September 8, 2026, and a request to discuss AI Flock cameras was referred to an executive session.
decisions: Referred the National Grid request for a new utility pole at 480 Westford Street to the Wire Inspector for report and recommendation.
Referred C. Liang's request to study revitalizing North Common Park with an 'Acre Walk of Immigrants' theme to the City Manager.
Denied C. McDonough's motion asking the City Manager to study legal action, including appeals under MGL 40 S 81BB, to enforce land use regulations.
Approved having the City Auditor alter the pay period for school employees around the Labor Day holiday, 9-0 with 2 recused.
Adopted the City Manager's request for out-of-state travel for WasteWater, 11-0.
Adopted the City Manager's request for out-of-state travel for the Manager Department/City Council, 11-0.
Adopted the City Manager's request for out-of-state travel for the Manager Department, 11-0.
Adopted acceptance and expenditure of a $117k Jail/Arrest Diversion Program Grant, 11-0.
Adopted acceptance and expenditure of a $400 Letters About Literature Program Grant, 11-0.
Adopted applying for, accepting, and expending a $118,915 Green Communities Competitive Grant, 11-0.
Adopted authorizing the City Manager to enter a license agreement with Fork Included, LLC, 11-0.
Adopted authorizing the City Manager to execute a Land Disposition Agreement with WinnDevelopment Company Limited Partnership for Parcels 11 and 12, 11-0.
Adopted transferring $251,268.75 as a supplemental appropriation for the HHS Lease, 10-1.
Adopted transferring $358,559 in Opioid Settlement Funds, 11-0.
Continued the Finance Subcommittee report of August 11, 2026 to September 8, 2026.
Continued the Rules & Election Law Subcommittee report of August 18, 2026 to September 8, 2026.
Accepted and adopted the Wire Inspector's orders on several gas main and utility pole requests.
Referred David Trainor's request to discuss AI Flock camera use to a scheduled Executive Session of the full Council.
Referred the National Grid request for a new utility pole at 26 Caddell Avenue to a public hearing on September 8, 2026.
Referred the Boston Gas request to replace cast iron gas main on Middlesex Street to a public hearing on September 8, 2026.
